name: Beijing Join-Cheer Software Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Join-Cheer Software Co., Ltd. provides management software and digital communication in China. It provides government management services, enterprise group management and control, intelligent transportation, education, digital communication, government big data, enterprise big data, and internal control. The company serves e-government, group management, control and digital communication sectors. Beijing Join-Cheer Software Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
